scenarioFindings.rationale: Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Confirmed fringe exclusion, no forceful stretching, draft versus finalized measurement, separate end/centre figures rather than averaging, and permission before handoff. Rewrote all locale turn-6 hints so the fabric is remeasured and the result/reason reported, rather than remeasuring a record. Clarified English instruction-sheet dimension and Khmer whether-width-is-consistent condition.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Checked cable inclusion versus separate charging supply, battery-powered alternative, three AA cells versus only two at home, matching package type and no mixing old/new cells. Corrected Indonesian hint from requesting ordinary batteries to viewing a battery-powered light, Nepali/English hints to personal possession of a charging supply, and Traditional Chinese AA naming to avoid regional number confusion.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Recorded quiet-room request is not a guaranteed location; change remains subject to same-type vacancy. Checked unchanged booked price/type, prioritizing quiet over view, original no-breakfast booking, changed room number and next-morning settlement explanation. Repaired English grammar/request wording, Tagalog listening-to-payment explanation, and Nepali breakfast-specific wording to avoid general meal exclusion.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Checked today-valid bus timetable versus old travel-site photo seen last night; long route reduces buffer, ordinary shoes/no mountain gear support short visitor path, luggage pickup precedes stop, and current service must be checked on return. Restored complete action sequence and explicit not-relying-only-on-old-times clause in Tagalog and Burmese turn 10. No route duration or service guarantee added.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Waist fits but hems long; final length is deferred until work shoes brought tomorrow. Next-Monday use is requested, not a rush-completion guarantee; finish date follows length check. Purchase today does not authorize cutting or place hemming order. Repaired Tagalog possible-completion check to avoid assurance, clarified English no hemming order yet, and Thai question particle.

Read Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Distinguished sender/recipient from first-listed name, summary from original document, enlarged replica versus exhibited original, permitted handling/turning only for replica, no bending, use/return on table. Clarified English first-listed name and seal viewing, Indonesian reading-help question, Traditional Chinese physical-touch prohibition, and Nepali request to see enlarged seal.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Railway status is not proof of personal boarding/company arrival; station arrival is nine and boarding has not occurred. Checked destination, waiting message, viewed/update times, employer-specific document recheck and later boarding-time report separately. Repaired Traditional Chinese execution/file terminology to railway service/documents, and Indonesian/Nepali/Burmese station-arrival hints so they do not request a nonexistent unboarded-time event.

Read Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Two fallen variety labels have unknown tray origins; similar leaves are not adequate identification. Both labels stay in receiving tray; layout unchanged and prior photo has unreadable text. Photo/discovery position aid layout verification; reinsertion awaits confirmation and permission. Repaired two Tagalog discovery-location hints with malformed wording; no guessed variety assignment or authorization added.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Diagram colours encode warp/weft directions rather than real thread colours or proven fading. Enlarged photo is for identifying crossing threads, glass must not be touched, material label is below work title and note-taking permission is conditional on a clear passage. Repaired Thai fading wording and Burmese fabric-material question; no colour, material or handling permission inferred.

Read full Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. One newly inserted weft row is to be undone, not warp cut; nothing has been cut, thread end stays and tools are put down while instructor demonstrates. Learner requests row confirmation after observing and supervision initially when their turn is called. No semantic edit necessary; preserved demonstration-before-self-work and request rather than unconfirmed permission.

Read Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Assortment cannot be changed and was never entered; order is four individual skewers, two tsukune with sauce and two thighs split salt/sauce, tsukune same plate, thigh flavours separate. Friend cannot eat liver but no allergy or safety assurance inferred. Repaired Burmese substitution sentence and broken specify-flavour hint, plus Thai thigh naming consistency.

Read Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. New cable obstructs mapped route, alternate route blocked by another teams materials. No unplugging/moving cables or unauthorized materials clearing; notify transport staff to wait, report photo/location plus alternative condition, coordinator checks both owners, resume only after usable route confirmed and all informed. Repaired Hindi negation scope so both unplugging and shifting are prohibited, Traditional Chinese passage verb and Tagalog personal notification action.

Read Japanese and all 12 sentence/hint sets. Today is employer document deadline, not next-month payday/transfer; opening completion not promised. Application receipt differs from opened/usable account, no old unrelated placeholder number, employer extension precedes identity/document checks and number submission follows opening result. Repaired corrupted Traditional Chinese avoid-submitting hint, Thai question/reporting particles, Burmese identity-verification wording and English not-yet-issued phrasing.
